# Town of Richford municipal roster backfill -- Vermont

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 142 (Town of Richford): section 202(a): town officers are those provided by general law
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Richford, 2025 Town Report, TOWN OFFICERS table (report p. 7); the 2026 warning is printed at report p. 9 (floor meeting March 2, 2026; ballot March 3, 2026): Marianne Hall, Moderator on a one-year term; the 2026 warning, Article 2, elects a Moderator (one year), a Selectman for two years, a Selectman for three years, two Listers (three years), a First Constable (one year), four Planning Commission members (three years), and three Directors of the Richford Community Fund Inc (three years). The 2026 outcome is published nowhere official, so the post is created without a membership
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 142 (Town of Richford): section 202(a): town officers are those provided by general law
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk

Town of Richford, 2025 Town Report, TOWN OFFICERS table (report p. 7); the 2026 warning is printed at report p. 9 (floor meeting March 2, 2026; ballot March 3, 2026): Kiley Deuso, Town Clerk on a three-year term to 2027; the seat did not stand in 2026
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Kiley Deuso as Richford's Town Clerk

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 142 (Town of Richford): section 202(a): town officers are those provided by general law; section 203 makes the Treasurer the collector of taxes ('The Town shall not elect other collectors of current or delinquent taxes'), so Richford has no separate collector of delinquent taxes post
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer

Town of Richford, 2025 Town Report, TOWN OFFICERS table (report p. 7); the 2026 warning is printed at report p. 9 (floor meeting March 2, 2026; ballot March 3, 2026): Kiley Deuso, Town Treasurer on a three-year term to 2027; the seat did not stand in 2026
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Kiley Deuso as Richford's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists four of Richford's five selectboard members: Joseph Desmarais, Stephen Fletcher, Kristin Murphy, and Wallace Steinhour

Town of Richford, Select Board page (richfordvt.org): the current board is Wallace Steinhour (Chair), Alan Fletcher (Vice Chair), Joseph Desmarais, Stephen Fletcher, and Kristin Murphy (the report table spells the chair 'Steinour'; the board page's Steinhour governs). The two seats that stood in 2026 were held by Sherry Paquette and Andrew Pond, who departed

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers of three on staggered three-year terms

Town of Richford, 2025 Town Report, TOWN OFFICERS table (report p. 7); the 2026 warning is printed at report p. 9 (floor meeting March 2, 2026; ballot March 3, 2026): lister Eric Collins serves to 2027; the 2026 warning, Article 2, elects a Moderator (one year), a Selectman for two years, a Selectman for three years, two Listers (three years), a First Constable (one year), four Planning Commission members (three years), and three Directors of the Richford Community Fund Inc (three years) -- two lister seats stood in 2026
Town of Richford, Municipal Directory (richfordvt.org): Jon Hancock is a current lister. One of the two seats that stood in 2026 remains unfilled
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a first constable for a one-year term

Town of Richford, 2025 Town Report, TOWN OFFICERS table (report p. 7); the 2026 warning is printed at report p. 9 (floor meeting March 2, 2026; ballot March 3, 2026): Jeremy Paquette, First Constable; the 2026 warning, Article 2, elects a Moderator (one year), a Selectman for two years, a Selectman for three years, two Listers (three years), a First Constable (one year), four Planning Commission members (three years), and three Directors of the Richford Community Fund Inc (three years). The 2026 outcome is published nowhere official, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Richford, Planning Commission page (richfordvt.org): the commission is elected in Richford (the 2026 warning elects four members to three-year terms) and currently sits as Laura Hancock (Chair), Jacques Desautels, Arthur Pond, Mark Waterhouse, Rachel Dollar, Karen Cangelosi, and Sherry Paquette; Marc Jaffee departed
